title: YOLOv5 Model Loading
description: Begins with a plain-language explanation of hub custom checkpoint, model variants, and confidence, then traces the corresponding implementation and its limits in vehicle-number-plate-recognition.
learning_objectives: Explain hub custom checkpoint, model variants, and confidence in plain language and connect it to models/yolo.py; models/yolov5s.yaml; models/yolov5x.yaml.
Trace one input through the yolov5 model loading stage and identify its output and assumptions.
Diagnose one failure mode or limitation before extending this stage.
prerequisites: Read project prerequisites and the previous module when present.
concepts_covered: hub custom checkpoint, model variants, and confidence
practical_outcomes: Trace the yolov5 model loading stage through the cited source paths.
Produce a small test or diagnostic for hub custom checkpoint, model variants, and confidence.
completion_criteria: Complete the three lessons and exercise.
Answer all ten module questions using material from these lessons.
Submit a short source citation and limitation note.
